goal: Enable testing of BIP 54 Consensus Cleanup rules in Bitcoin Core without activating them on mainnet
Fix legacy consensus vulnerabilities including timewarp attacks, 64-byte Merkle collisions, and sigop DoS
reviewability: Ready for review with nothing known to invalidate a review
agreement: Broad concept support across contributors with no active blocking objections
Concept approval without stated reasons (dergoegge, fanquake, hsjoberg, nervana21, stickies-v, theStack)
Resolved objection regarding miner enforcement of difficulty adjustment rules (fjahr)
Resolved objection regarding pre-activation rejection categorization (polespinasa)
Unanswered question regarding cache behavior and mempool reorg test coverage (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes longstanding consensus vulnerabilities like timewarp attacks and Merkle collisions
It prepares node software for soft fork activation by allowing validation testing on regtest
Immediate mainnet impact is minimal because the rules remain inactive outside regtest
